name: list_folders
description:
List mail folders with their special use (drafts, sent, trash, ...) and message and unread
counts.

name: search
description:
Search a folder (default INBOX) by from, to, subject, text, date range (since/before,
YYYY-MM-DD) and unread state. Returns uid, date, from, subject, size and has_attachments,
newest first.

arguments.name: folder
arguments.desc: Folder to search (default INBOX). Names as list_folders returns them.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Most messages to return, newest first (default 20, at most 100).

arguments.name: since
arguments.desc: Received on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: Substring anywhere in the headers or the body.

arguments.name: unseen
arguments.desc: true: only unread messages; false: only read messages.

name: read_message
description:
Read one message: headers, plain-text body (HTML converted) and the attachment list
(index, name, type, size). Leaves the message unread unless mark_read is true.

arguments.name: mark_read
arguments.desc: Set the message's read flag (default false: reading leaves it unread).

arguments.name: max_chars
arguments.desc: Most body characters to return (default 20000, at most 200000).

name: read_attachment
description:
Read the text of one attachment of a message (text, HTML, PDF, DOCX, XLSX/XLS/ODS; other
types return metadata only). Index comes from read_message.

arguments.name: max_chars
arguments.desc: Most characters to return (default 20000, at most 200000).
